title: Save. Stay. The match is yours.
subtitle: A sponsor's match, reserved on-chain the moment you deposit and earned in a straight line.

firstStep.title: A sponsor funds a match
firstStep.description: They lock tokens in a pool and set the rules: the match rate, the most one saver can deposit, how long the match takes to vest, and when deposits close.

secondStep.title: You deposit SPYx
secondStep.description: The matching amount is reserved for you on-chain in the same transaction. If the pool can't match in full, you see that before you sign.

thirdStep.title: The match vests
thirdStep.description: In a straight line, starting the moment you deposit. You can claim what has vested at any time.

fourthStep.title: Leave whenever you like
fourthStep.description: You always get your whole deposit back. Match that hasn't vested returns to the sponsor; what has vested stays yours.

summary: Rules that can't change once a pool exists, and numbers anyone can check.

illustration.label: A vesting line: the match rises in a straight line from the day of the deposit. Leaving early returns the part that has not vested yet to the sponsor.
illustration.unvested: Not vested yet: returns to the sponsor if you leave
